newsitem.title: UK: Single Brent cargo clocked to Texaco - trade.
newsitem.headline: Single Brent cargo clocked to Texaco - trade.

text.p: The single Brent cargo turning wet from the paper chains on Thursday was clocked to U.S. refiner Texaco at the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargo was due to load in the date range July 25-27.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days ahead before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a cargo which has changed from paper to physical at the deadline and therefore can no longer be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
